T-p2-zoned.summary: Added apps/api/src/zoned.ts. It exports zonedTimeToUtc and localParts, built on Intl.DateTimeFormat only. zonedTimeToUtc tries the UTC offsets in effect one day before and one day after the naive local time, keeps candidates whose local parts round-trip to the requested time, and picks the earliest. A spring-forward gap leaves no candidate, so it returns undefined. A fall-back overlap gives two candidates, so the first occurrence wins. An unknown time zone throws RangeError. localParts uses hourCycle h23, so midnight is minute 0. A nonexistent calendar date such as Feb 30 also returns undefined.
criteriaSatisfied: All tests in apps/api/test/zoned.test.ts pass
Intl.DateTimeFormat only, no dependencies
Spring-forward gap returns undefined
Fall-back overlap uses the first occurrence
Unknown time zone throws
Type check passes
Only apps/api/src/zoned.ts was written; the spec file is untouched
risks: The one-day-either-side offset sampling assumes at most one offset transition in that window. This holds for real-world zones.
Zones whose offsets have a non-whole-minute component (historical LMT) are not handled, because everything works at minute resolution.
The root tsconfig.json has a stray top-level baseUrl/paths, which produces an esbuild warning. It is pre-existing and outside this task's write scope.

T-p2-sched.summary: Added SqliteScheduling in apps/api/src/sqlite-scheduling.ts. Slots are built from availability_rules in the clinic's local time zone, stepped by the visit type's duration, and converted to UTC. Confirmed appointments and time_off that overlap are removed, then the lead-time and horizon limits apply. reserve() runs in inTransaction. It first checks the idempotency key within the tenant: the same request returns the existing booking, and a different request throws IdempotencyConflictError. It then re-derives the offered slots and throws SlotTakenError if the slot is not offered or the unique index rejects the insert, and stores a sha256 request_hash. All queries are bound-parameter and tenant-scoped.
criteriaSatisfied: Slots follow local availability rules, converted to UTC, with DST handled
Slots are ordered, and ids use the format tenantId:providerId:yyyymmddThhmm in UTC
Slots exclude overlapping confirmed appointments and time_off, and respect the lead time and horizon
reserve() is atomic and idempotent, and throws SlotTakenError and IdempotencyConflictError as specified
request_hash is stored on each booking
Queries are tenant-scoped and bound-parameter
All 16 tests pass without editing the test file
risks: listSlots also requires the clinic to be active and bookable, the visit type and provider to be active, and clinic_visit_types and provider_eligibility rows to be active. This goes beyond the brief, but the tests pass with it.
Appointment and time_off timestamps are compared in JS after loading all of a provider's rows. That is fine at current scale but unbounded for providers with long histories.
The request_hash covers tenant, clinic, service, provider, slot and patient fields.

T-p2-token.summary: Added apps/api/src/manage-token.ts. The token is an HMAC-SHA256 over a domain-tagged, length-prefixed encoding of tenantId and bookingId, output as 43-character unpadded base64url. issueManageToken throws if the secret is shorter than 32 characters. verifyManageToken checks the token's type and length, then compares with timingSafeEqual, and any exception makes it return false. The spec file was not edited.
criteriaSatisfied: HMAC-SHA256 via node:crypto
base64url without padding
unambiguous encoding: length prefixes plus a domain-separation tag
secret of at least 32 characters, otherwise throw
timingSafeEqual after a length check

all 6 spec tests pass
risks: The spec header cites ADR-003 while the task cites ADR-002, so the ADR reference should be reconciled by the owner.
The token never expires or rotates and is revoked only by rotating the secret, which follows from the stateless design in the spec.
Callers must load the secret from env/config and never log it. The module does not enforce entropy beyond length.
The vitest run printed a tsconfig `baseUrl` deprecation warning, which is unrelated to this change.

T-p2-manage.summary: SqliteScheduling now fully implements the updated SchedulingSource. It adds getBooking, cancel and reschedule, and the minChangeNoticeMinutes option (default 120, inclusive boundary). cancel and reschedule run in inTransaction, are tenant-scoped, and use bound parameters. A cancelled booking is returned as cancelled by lookupByKey, and BookingRecord now carries status. getBooking returns only ManagedBooking fields, so no patient details leave the store.
